title: pce-uncertainty-attribution: code for "Interpretable attribution of decision-relevant uncertainty in AI"
description: A polynomial surrogate of a few trained models reveals which components of a learned model's uncertainty a decision depends on, and how much resolving each is worth, in chemistry, experimental design and language-model alignment. This is the version of the code used for the paper Interpretable attribution of decision-relevant uncertainty in AI (Nature Machine Intelligence, 2026): ensemble training, polynomial chaos expansion (PCE) surrogate fitting, Sobol' and Shapley computation, calibration, figure generation and the Lean 4 proofs. The root run script rebuilds every main-text figure from the committed result files and runs the unit tests (CPU only, about a minute); REPRODUCE.md has the per-figure recipes for the full experiments.
